posts.title: A portfolio was due for a long while.
posts.body:
I know, I should have done this a long while ago but I was waiting for the moment I had something show for.

as we near the end of 2026, I have successfully created 2 beautiful projects that I really love. Thank you to the people who worked with me and helped me bring both to life.
SFA and PTS has helped me educate myself about so many things. 

It was a good year for learning. May the future hold much more for all of us.
you can check out my projects at #projects.

posts.title: I have been writing.
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I hope you are doing very well. I wanted to wish everyone a very happy late November. After around a month and 10 days we will be officially leaving behind 2026. This has been truly an insane year for moving forward. we lost good people along the way. I think it is by moving forward is how you honor the people who stayed with you, for you.
I have been writing and working and I couldn't have been feeling better. A very hectic last week but I hope you guys are still reading my newspaper. until next time, love you always.
